'''Emissary''' is the 17th virtual expansion of [[Star Trek CCG 1st Edition]]. It is published by [[The Continuing Committee]] on December 6, 2013. This set consists of 85 cards. This set is part of the ''Deep Space Nine Block'' consisting of cards from [[Emissary]], [[Emissary: Supplemental]], [[Warp Pack: Emissary]], [[The Maquis]], and [[The Gamma Quadrant]],

The four alternate image cards without the TCC watermark were made available in July 2014.
